_comment: 3s Gentech. PU (gp1) and SPU (gp2) come off the hpbar text via
katmud_lib/gentech.py - no GMCP package carries either, and MIP/FFF is
gone mud-side (2026-09-15). The hpbar prints every combat round (and on
`hp` / `reclaim hp`), so the bars hold still out of combat. PU max is on
the hpbar; SPU max is half of it (game fact). CPC/reset/Edna/Efield/
Tactical/Stabilize/Rested come from GMCP into the info-pane status line.

triggers._pattern_note: Patterns are REGEX (re.compile, no auto-escape), so the brackets MUST be escaped. Unescaped, '[[ WARNING ...]]' parses as a character class + a literal ']' and matches ANY line with a common letter or space before a ']' - '[Notice]', '[chat]', '[Newbie]' all fired 'tactical'.
